lessons.title: Reading a candle
intro: Each candle shows four prices for one time period: open, high, low and close.
A green candle closed higher than it opened. A red candle closed lower.
The thin lines (wicks) show how far price travelled before settling.

questions.question: What does a green candle mean?
options: Price closed higher than it opened
Price closed lower than it opened
questions.explanation: Green means the close is above the open.

questions.question: What do the wicks show?
questions.explanation: Wicks mark the high and low reached during the period.

questions.question: How many prices does one candle summarise?
questions.explanation: Open, high, low and close: four prices.

questions.question: A long upper wick on a red candle suggests…
questions.explanation: Price went up but sellers pushed it back down before the close.
